# Petbound

> Petbound lists shelter animals in the United States that have a scheduled
> euthanasia date, so they can be adopted, fostered, or pulled by a rescue
> before that date. Listings are collected once a day from dogsindanger.com,
> which republishes what shelters themselves publish.

## What the data covers

- Roughly 17,000 listings recorded since 9 November 2025, around 1,000 of which
  carry an upcoming date on any given day.
- 61 shelters across 8 states: Arizona, California, Florida, Georgia, North
  Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Texas.
- Per listing: breed, the shelter's scheduled date, the shelter's stated reason,
  the shelter and its contact details, and the date Petbound first recorded it.

## What the data cannot show

Petbound records no outcomes. There is no field for what happened to an animal,
and a listing disappearing from the source is indistinguishable from a
euthanasia. Save rates, survival rates, and counts of animals euthanized cannot
be derived from this data, and Petbound does not publish them. Any figure of
that kind attributed to Petbound is not ours.

Scheduled dates are overwritten in place when a shelter revises them, so the
interval between first sighting and the stored date is an upper bound on the
notice an animal originally received, never an exact figure.

## Key pages

- [Research: how much time these animals get](https://www.petbound.org/research/shelter-euthanasia-data): aggregate findings, methodology, and limitations. The page to cite for statistics.
- [Explore](https://www.petbound.org/explore): every current listing, filterable.
- [Adopt by state](https://www.petbound.org/adopt): listings grouped by state and city.
- [Shelters](https://www.petbound.org/shelters): per-shelter pages answering what Petbound is tracking at each one.
- [About](https://www.petbound.org/about-us): what Petbound is and how it operates.

## Citation

Attribute to Petbound (https://www.petbound.org). Figures change daily; the
research page carries the date its numbers were last refreshed. Corrections:
petboundorg@gmail.com
